title: Complete IRCTC Authorized Agent Rules & Daily Operations Guide (2026)
excerpt: A comprehensive daily guide for IRCTC principal agents: booking time windows, ticket cancellation rules, service charge caps, and compliance essentials.
content:
Overview of IRCTC Authorized Agent Operations

Becoming an authorized IRCTC ticket booking agent provides a dependable commercial opportunity to assist rail passengers across India. Operating successfully on a daily basis requires strict adherence to IRCTC's operational guidelines, timing windows, and fair fee structures.

1. Permitted Booking Timings & Restrictions

IRCTC strictly regulates agent access to the booking inventory during peak rush periods to prioritize direct general passengers:

  • General Booking: Agents can book tickets throughout the day once open reservation opens.
  • Tatkal AC Windows: Standard Tatkal for AC classes opens at 10:00 AM for the public; agents are typically restricted from booking Tatkal tickets during the first 15 minutes (until 10:15 AM).
  • Tatkal Non-AC Windows: Non-AC Tatkal opens at 11:00 AM; agent booking opens at 11:15 AM.

2. Service Charge and Fair Pricing Norms

Principal agents must only levy the officially authorized service charges over and above the IRCTC ticket fare and PG charges:

  • Non-AC Classes (2S, SL): Up to ₹20 per ticket + GST.
  • AC Classes (3A, 2A, 1A, CC, EC): Up to ₹40 per ticket + GST.
  • Always issue a printed electronic reservation slip (ERS) clearly stating the breakdown of the base fare, agent commission, and taxes to avoid customer disputes.

3. Cancellation and Refund Workflow

When passengers request cancellations, authorized agents must follow the OTP-based refund verification procedure. An OTP is dispatched directly to the passenger's registered mobile number. Once confirmed by the passenger, the refund is credited back to the agent's wallet or payment source for immediate cash disbursement.

Summary

Following compliance protocols safeguards your agency license, avoids deactivation, and builds long-term customer trust in your ticketing business.

content:
Complete Guide to IRCTC Agent Registration & Operations

Operating as an authorized IRCTC train ticket booking agent is one of the most profitable business opportunities for travel agencies, cyber cafes, and CSC centers across India. With over 2 crore passengers traveling by Indian Railways daily, authorized agents provide a vital service to local communities.

In this guide, we provide everything you need to know about becoming an authorized agent, daily Tatkal booking rules, legal commission structures, and compliance requirements.

1. Key Commercial Advantages for Agents

Unlike personal IRCTC user accounts which are legally restricted to individual household use only, an authorized commercial agency license offers significant privileges:

  • Unlimited Ticket Booking: No monthly caps on the number of confirmed passenger tickets you can book.

  • Official Service Charges: Legally charge authorized booking fees on every issued ticket.

  • Agency Branding on ERS: Your agency name, address, and contact number appear directly on the passenger reservation slip.

  • Direct Wallet Integration: Dedicated agency booking portal with quick recharge options for fast checkout during rush hours.

  • Instant Cancellation Workflow: Secure OTP-based refund confirmations protect both you and your passengers.

2. Permissible Service Charges & Commission

IRCTC allows authorized agents to collect a fixed service charge per transaction over and above the train ticket fare:

3. Tatkal Booking Timing Windows

4. Required Documents for Registration

Keep scanned copies of the following documents ready before submitting your registration application:

  1. PAN Card: Must match the applicant's official name exactly.

  2. Aadhaar Card: Mobile number must be linked with Aadhaar for online OTP verification.

  3. Fresh Mobile Number & Email ID: Must never have been registered on IRCTC before.

  4. Business Address Proof: Electricity bill, rent agreement, or shop & establishment license.

  5. Cancelled Bank Cheque: Required for automated commission disbursements and cancellation refund credits.

5. Crucial Compliance Guidelines

To protect your license against deactivation or penalties from Indian Railways and IRCTC:

  • Never use personal IRCTC IDs: Commercial booking on personal IDs is a punishable offense under Section 143 of the Railways Act.

  • Always provide printed ERS: Give the passenger the official printout with clear fare breakdowns.

  • Verify passenger mobile numbers: Always enter the passenger's own mobile number so they receive direct PNR alerts and cancellation OTPs.
